goal: Require a dedicated bind when automatic Tor listening is used alongside custom bind settings
Prevent incoming Tor peers from misclassifying and inheriting local IP whitelist permissions
agreement: Concept and approach approval without stated reasons (jeanpablojp, winterrdog)
Resolved correctness objection on wildcard binds bypassing peer classification (jeanpablojp)

why: P2 because incoming Tor peers routed to default listening sockets can bypass peer isolation
